test_DatetimeIndex_round: test the DatetimeIndex.round method to round datetime values to a specified frequency like 'D' or 'h'
test_DatetimeIndex_floor: test the DatetimeIndex.floor method to floor datetime values to the nearest multiple of a given frequency
test_DatetimeIndex_ceil: test the DatetimeIndex.ceil method to ceil datetime values to the nearest multiple of a given frequency
test_round_timezone_aware: test DatetimeIndex.round with timezone-aware and timezone-converted datetime indices
test_round_subsecond_precision: test DatetimeIndex.round with sub-second frequencies such as 'ns', 'us', 'ms', and custom multiples like '10ns'
test_round_invalid_frequency: test DatetimeIndex.round raises ValueError for invalid or non-fixed frequencies like 'ME' or 'foobar'
test_Timestamp_round: test the Timestamp.round method to round individual timestamp values to a specified frequency
test_round_half_to_even: test DatetimeIndex.round uses round-half-to-even (banker's rounding) for tie-breaking at half intervals
test_ceil_floor_edge_cases: test DatetimeIndex.ceil and floor with edge cases including NaT values and exact boundary timestamps
test_round_no_rounding: test DatetimeIndex.round with a frequency matching the index frequency results in no rounding
